headword: {走り続ける|はしりつづける}
gloss: to keep running; to continue running

definitions.gloss: to keep running; to continue running
definitions.explanation: To physically continue running without stopping, as in a marathon, a chase, or sustained exercise over a period of time.

definitions.gloss: to keep going; to keep pushing forward (figurative)
definitions.explanation: Used metaphorically to describe persisting in one's efforts, staying at the forefront, or continuing to strive toward a goal without giving up.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けた。
ゴールまで{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けよう。
examples.english: Let's keep running until the finish line.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{中|なか}を{二時間|にじかん}も{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けて、{足|あし}がガクガクになった。
examples.english: I kept running for two hours in the rain, and my legs were shaking.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}に{向|む}かって{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける。
examples.english: To keep pushing forward toward one's dream.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{業界|ぎょうかい}のトップを{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: She continues to lead the industry.

examples.japanese: {創業|そうぎょう}から{五十年|ごじゅうねん}、この{会社|かいしゃ}は{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けてきた。
examples.english: For fifty years since its founding, this company has kept moving forward.

notes:
A compound verb combining {走|はし}る (to run) with {続|つづ}ける (to continue). In its literal sense, it means to keep running physically. In its figurative sense, it means to keep striving or pushing forward, often used in motivational or inspirational contexts.

VERB FORM:
Ichidan verb ({走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける). Conjugates on the {続|つづ}ける portion: {走|はし}り{続|つづ}けます, {走|はし}り{続|つづ}けた, {走|はし}り{続|つづ}けて, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ~を{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける: to keep running (a course/path)
- ~に{向|む}かって{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける: to keep running toward ~
- トップを{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける: to stay at the top

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}く — to run through to the end; emphasizes completing the course
- {駆|か}け{続|つづ}ける — to keep dashing; more literary
- {歩|あゆ}み{続|つづ}ける — to keep walking forward; gentler metaphor
